not_client_data: Synthetic demonstration data, generated by CreditProbe v5 from the synthetic books. Branch names are Saudi cities and districts; no real branch network, staffing or person is described.

dictionary.region: The book's own region for the customer; the branch is always in it.
dictionary.area: Regional area of the bank's network: Central, Western, Eastern, Northern, Southern.
dictionary.corporate_desk: 1 when the branch books corporate borrowers.
dictionary.business_unit: Corporate business unit: Large Corporates for the book's Strategic tier, otherwise the regional Corporate Banking unit of the borrower's region.
dictionary.rm_id: Relationship manager id (RM####), one per borrower, of the borrower's business unit.
dictionary.base_branch_id: The branch the RM sits in.

derivations.retail_score_band: Read from the book: customer score_band (EWS release column customer_score_band).
derivations.retail_salaried: Read from the book: employment_type (Salaried-Private, Salaried-Government = Salaried; Self-employed, Non-salaried = Non-Salaried).
derivations.retail_vintage: Read from the book: account vintage_year (origination year).
